# Aditya Patil — Independent Systems Engineer

> Aditya Patil builds operational software that survives real production use — reporting automation, internal dashboards, realtime monitoring, AI workflows, and autonomous AI agents. Based in Pune, India. Serves clients across India, UK, US, and remote worldwide.

Aditya is a Lead Software Engineer at a renewable energy SaaS company where he architects production systems managing 3,400+ MW of live plant data across 40+ sites. On the side he takes on independent projects for founders and operations leads. Fixed-scope, fixed-price engagements, delivered as promised.

## About Aditya

- Role: Lead Software Engineer + Independent Delivery Partner
- Location: Pune, India (serves clients worldwide)
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 93732 38164
- Website: https://adityapatil.work

## Production experience

- Reporting automation pipelines running daily across 33+ industrial sites
- Forecasting & scheduling platforms managing 3,400+ MW across 40+ plants
- Realtime monitoring systems with sub-500ms telemetry, WebSockets/MQTT/OPC-UA
- AI agents shipped in production: OpsFlow (monitors 35+ sites) and autonomous forecasting agent
- Deviation & settlement reconciliation portals for multi-plant portfolios
- Indie products live: GoSolarIndex.in, MSMEVault.in
